            # ============================= BUYS ==============================
            # Slot 1 buy: SPY close crosses above its 100-day SMA.
            if self.lot_a == 0:
                crossed_above = (prev_spy_close <= prev_sma) and (spy_close > today_sma)
                if crossed_above:
                    target_value = self.SLOT1_PORTFOLIO_PCT * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)
                    quantity = int(target_value / spy_close)
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                        self.lot_a = quantity

            # Slot 2 buy: AAPL red for 3 or more consecutive days.
            if self.lot_b == 0:
                if self.aapl_red_streak >= self.RED_STREAK_REQUIRED:
                    available_cash = float(self.Portfolio.Cash)
                    if available_cash >= self.SLOT2_DOLLARS:
                        quantity = int(self.SLOT2_DOLLARS / aapl_close)
                        if quantity > 0:
                            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                            self.lot_b = quantity
                    # otherwise: do nothing this bar, stay flat, reason may fire later

        # ---- roll market state forward for tomorrow's comparisons ----
        for ticker, bar in bars.items():
            self.prev_close[ticker] = float(bar.Close)
        self.prev_spy_sma = today_sma
        self.prev_aapl_rsi = today_rsi

        self.lot_a = 0                # Strategy A lot in SPY
        self.lot_b = 0                # Strategy B lot in AAPL

        self.set_warm_up(150, Resolution.DAILY)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- main event
    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
        bars = {}
        for ticker, symbol in self.symbol_map.items():
            bar = data.bars.get(symbol) if data.bars is not None else None
            if bar is not None:
                bars[ticker] = bar

        self._strategy_b_sell(aapl_rsi)

        if "AAPL" in bars:

            if previous is None:

            elif close < previous:

            else:

        if self.lot_a != 0:

        target_value = 0.40 * self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value
        shares = int(math.floor(target_value / close))
        if shares <= 0:
            return

        self.market_order(self.spy, shares)
        self.lot_a = shares

        if self.lot_a <= 0:
            return
        # cross below: yesterday close >= yesterday SMA and today close < today SMA

            return

        self.market_order(self.spy, -self.lot_a)
        self.lot_a = 0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- strategy B
    def _strategy_b_buy(self, close):
        if self.lot_b != 0:
            return
        if self.aapl_red_streak < 3:
            return

        budget = 20_000.0
        if self.portfolio.cash < budget:
            return  # do nothing this bar; the reason may fire again later

        shares = int(math.floor(budget / close))
        if shares <= 0:

        self.market_order(self.aapl, shares)
        self.lot_b = shares

        if self.lot_b <= 0:
            return
        if rsi_value <= 60:
            return

        self.market_order(self.aapl, -self.lot_b)
        self.lot_b = 0

    any bar sells are evaluated before buys.
    """

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ setup
    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1_000_000)

        self.tickers = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in self.tickers:
            equity = self.add_equity(ticker, Resolution.DAILY)
            self.symbols[ticker] = equity.symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        # ---- Strategy A market state (continuously computed from data) ----
        self.spy_sma = self.sma(self.spy, 100, Resolution.DAILY)
        self.spy_close_window = RollingWindow[float](2)   # [0] = today, [1] = yesterday
        self.spy_sma_window = RollingWindow[float](2)

        # ---- Strategy B market state (continuously computed from data) ----
        self.aapl_rsi = self.rsi(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.WILDERS, Resolution.DAILY)
        self.aapl_prev_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        # ---- Private lots ----
        self.lot_a = 0   # Strategy A shares of SPY
        self.lot_b = 0   # Strategy B shares of AAPL

        self.set_benchmark(self.spy)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- main loop
    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
        # 1) Market-state quantities are ALWAYS updated from whatever data arrives.
        self._update_spy_state(data)
        self._update_aapl_state(data)

        # 2) If today's bar is missing for ANY subscribed ticker, skip ALL rule evaluation.
        for symbol in self.symbols.values():
            if not self._has_bar(data, symbol):
                return

        # 3) Do not trade until every indicator / rolling window is fully formed.
        if not self._history_ready():
            return

        spy_close = float(data[self.spy].close)
        aapl_close = float(data[self.aapl].close)

        # 4) Sells before buys, for every slot.
        self._strategy_a_sell(spy_close)
        self._strategy_b_sell()

        self._strategy_a_buy(spy_close)
        self._strategy_b_buy(aapl_close)

    # -------------------------------------------------- market-state updates
    def _update_spy_state(self, data: Slice):
        if not self._has_bar(data, self.spy):
            return
        if not self.spy_sma.is_ready:
            return
        self.spy_close_window.add(float(data[self.spy].close))
        self.spy_sma_window.add(float(self.spy_sma.current.value))

    def _update_aapl_state(self, data: Slice):
        if not self._has_bar(data, self.aapl):
            return
        close = float(data[self.aapl].close)
        if self.aapl_prev_close is not None:
            if close < self.aapl_prev_close:      # strictly below previous close = red day
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.aapl_prev_close = close

    def _history_ready(self) -> bool:
        return (self.spy_sma.is_ready
                and self.aapl_rsi.is_ready
                and self.spy_close_window.is_ready
                and self.spy_sma_window.is_ready
                and self.aapl_prev_close is not None)

    @staticmethod
    def _has_bar(data: Slice, symbol) -> bool:
        if not data.contains_key(symbol):
            return False
        bar = data[symbol]
        return bar is not None and bar.close > 0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ crossovers
    def _crossed_above(self) -> bool:
        """Yesterday close <= SMA, today close > SMA."""
        return (self.spy_close_window[1] <= self.spy_sma_window[1]
                and self.spy_close_window[0] > self.spy_sma_window[0])

    def _crossed_below(self) -> bool:
        """Yesterday close >= SMA, today close < SMA."""
        return (self.spy_close_window[1] >= self.spy_sma_window[1]
                and self.spy_close_window[0] < self.spy_sma_window[0])

    # ---------------------------------------------- Slot 1 - Strategy A (SPY)
    def _strategy_a_sell(self, spy_close: float):
        if self.lot_a <= 0:
            return
        if self._crossed_below():
            self.market_order(self.spy, -self.lot_a)
            self.debug(f"{self.time.date()} A SELL {self.lot_a} SPY @ {spy_close:.2f} (cross below SMA100)")
            self.lot_a = 0

    def _strategy_a_buy(self, spy_close: float):
        if self.lot_a > 0:
            return
        if not self._crossed_above():
            return
        target_value = 0.40 * float(self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value)
        quantity = int(math.floor(target_value / spy_close))
        if quantity <= 0:
            return
        self.market_order(self.spy, quantity)
        self.lot_a = quantity
        self.debug(f"{self.time.date()} A BUY {quantity} SPY @ {spy_close:.2f} (cross above SMA100)")

    # --------------------------------------------- Slot 2 - Strategy B (AAPL)
    def _strategy_b_sell(self):
        if self.lot_b <= 0:
            return
        if float(self.aapl_rsi.current.value) > 60.0:
            self.market_order(self.aapl, -self.lot_b)
            self.debug(f"{self.time.date()} B SELL {self.lot_b} AAPL (RSI14 = {self.aapl_rsi.current.value:.2f} > 60)")
            self.lot_b = 0

    def _strategy_b_buy(self, aapl_close: float):
        if self.lot_b > 0:
            return
        if self.aapl_red_streak < 3:
            return
        budget = 20_000.0
        if float(self.portfolio.cash) < budget:
            return  # not enough available cash -> do nothing this bar
        quantity = int(math.floor(budget / aapl_close))
        if quantity <= 0:
            return
        self.market_order(self.aapl, quantity)
        self.lot_b = quantity
        self.debug(f"{self.time.date()} B BUY {quantity} AAPL @ {aapl_close:.2f} (3 red days)")

    def _update_spy_state(self, data: Slice):
        if not self._has_bar(data, self.spy):
            return
        if not self.spy_sma.is_ready:
            return
        self.spy_close_window.add(float(data[self.spy].close))
        self.spy_sma_window.add(float(self.spy_sma.current.value))

    def _update_aapl_state(self, data: Slice):
        if not self._has_bar(data, self.aapl):
            return
        close = float(data[self.aapl].close)
        if self.aapl_prev_close is not None:
            if close < self.aapl_prev_close:      # strictly below previous close = red day
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.aapl_prev_close = close

    def _history_ready(self) -> bool:
        return (self.spy_sma.is_ready
                and self.aapl_rsi.is_ready
                and self.spy_close_window.is_ready
                and self.spy_sma_window.is_ready
                and self.aapl_prev_close is not None)

    @staticmethod
    def _has_bar(data: Slice, symbol) -> bool:
        if not data.contains_key(symbol):
            return False
        bar = data[symbol]
        return bar is not None and bar.close > 0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ crossovers
    def _crossed_above(self) -> bool:
        """Yesterday close <= SMA, today close > SMA."""
        return (self.spy_close_window[1] <= self.spy_sma_window[1]
                and self.spy_close_window[0] > self.spy_sma_window[0])

    def _crossed_below(self) -> bool:
        """Yesterday close >= SMA, today close < SMA."""
        return (self.spy_close_window[1] >= self.spy_sma_window[1]
                and self.spy_close_window[0] < self.spy_sma_window[0])

    def _strategy_a_sell(self, spy_close: float):
        if self.lot_a <= 0:
            return
        if self._crossed_below():
            self.market_order(self.spy, -self.lot_a)
            self.debug(f"{self.time.date()} A SELL {self.lot_a} SPY @ {spy_close:.2f} (cross below SMA100)")
            self.lot_a = 0

    def _strategy_a_buy(self, spy_close: float):
        if self.lot_a > 0:
            return
        if not self._crossed_above():
            return
        target_value = 0.40 * float(self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value)
        quantity = int(math.floor(target_value / spy_close))
        if quantity <= 0:
            return
        self.market_order(self.spy, quantity)
        self.lot_a = quantity
        self.debug(f"{self.time.date()} A BUY {quantity} SPY @ {spy_close:.2f} (cross above SMA100)")

    def _strategy_b_sell(self):

            self.debug(f"{self.time.date()} B SELL {self.lot_b} AAPL (RSI14 = {self.aapl_rsi.current.value:.2f} > 60)")
